newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bovespa trades $23.5 billion in June.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bovespa trades $23.5 billion in June.

text.p: Market turnover at the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) in June totalled $23.5 billion, with an average daily volume of $1.1 billion, up 63.2 percent from the previous month, the bolsa said.
The spot market accounted for 88.6 percent of total trade, followed by the options market with 11 percent and the forward market with 0.4 percent, it said in a statement.
The stock exchange also said the Bovespa index, comprising the 47 most liquid stocks, rose 10.8 percent in June. In the first half, stocks rose 78.5 percent.
